description: Carry out the person's answer to a page that held more than one recipe, with the choices the recipe page offers: OneDish keeps the page as one dish with parts, Only keeps just the dish at index, All saves every whole dish as its own recipe. Take importId and index from import_recipe_from_url's page or get_recipe's pageQuestion. Ask the person which first.

index.description: With Only: the dish's index on the page.
